pipeline_name: Badr El Din Spur Gas Pipelines

resolutions.researcher_notes: Egypt Oil & Gas Newspaper, March 2020 Issue 159 'The Western Desert' feature. url_verifier returns HTTP 200; the substring screen FAILs on the PDF (documented ligature/PDF false-negative) but pdftotext + pypdf extraction confirm the exact string 'Badr El Din Spur (2)' in the 'Natural Gas Infrastructure in the Western Desert' table. Status 'operating' is inferred, not literal: the line appears in the existing (not planned) Western Desert gas infrastructure table serving live southern-field gas gathering to GPC's Abu Sennan processing plant. Single strong independent trade source; no second independent source found for this internal gathering spur (web search returned only GEM surfaces and unrelated BED-concession discovery news).

PDF text confirms 'Badr El Din Spur (2)' is listed under 'Natural Gas Infrastructure in the Western Desert' — Fuel=Gas confirmed directly. HTTP 200; PDF-encoding substring false-negative, content verified via pdftotext/pypdf.

PDF gas-infrastructure table (columns Diameter/Capacity(mmcf/d)/Length aligned to the 13-pipeline list) gives Badr El Din Spur (2) Capacity = 150 mmcf/d, matching GEM's 150.00 MMcf/d exactly. HTTP 200; PDF substring false-negative, content verified via pdftotext/pypdf.

PDF gas-infrastructure table gives Badr El Din Spur (2) Length = 130 km, matching GEM's 130.00 km exactly. Note the same table lists Badr El Din Spur (1) also at 130 km. HTTP 200; PDF substring false-negative, content verified via pdftotext/pypdf.
PDF gas-infrastructure table gives Badr El Din Spur (2) Diameter = 16 in, matching GEM's 16.00 in exactly. HTTP 200; PDF substring false-negative, content verified via pdftotext/pypdf.

The FuelSource value IS this PDF URL. Confirmed live (HTTP 200) and it is the Egypt Oil & Gas Western Desert feature documenting the Badr El Din / Abu Sennan gas gathering system — describes southern Western Desert fields (Badr El Din, Abu Gharadig, Abu Sennan) feeding GPC's Abu Sennan gas/condensate plant. Content verified via pdftotext/pypdf.

PDF gas table lists Badr El Din Spur (2) From = 'Badr El Din Fields' (matches StartLocation 'Badr El Din Field', StartState Western Desert) and To = 'BED/Abu Sennan connector' (matches EndPrefecture 'Abu Sennan', EndState Matruh). Both endpoints in Egypt's Western Desert. HTTP 200; PDF substring false-negative, content verified via pdftotext/pypdf.

PDF narrative: 'General Petroleum Company (GPC) established a plant for gas and condensate processing in Abu Sennan...' and identifies GPC as operator of the southern Western Desert gas gathering system into which the BED spurs feed — supports Owner1 = General Petroleum Co (100%). The source ties GPC to the system rather than stating pipeline title ownership explicitly, so treat as medium. HTTP 200; PDF substring false-negative, content verified via pdftotext/pypdf.
